locations.name: Main Gate
locations.directions: The main entrance on LASU Road, Ojo.

locations.name: Faculty of Engineering & Technology (FET)
locations.directions: From the main gate, go straight for 500m, turn right at the first major junction. FET Auditorium is on your left.

locations.name: Faculty of Management Sciences (FMS)
locations.directions: From the main gate, walk straight for about 300m. FMS is the large building on your right after the roundabout.

locations.name: Faculty of Law
locations.directions: From the main gate, take the right fork and walk for 200m. The Faculty of Law building is beside the mini-stadium.

locations.name: Senate Building / Admin Block
locations.directions: Directly behind the main gate, about 100m straight ahead. The tallest building on campus.

locations.name: University Library
locations.directions: From the main gate, go straight and turn left at the roundabout. The library is a large two-storey building on your right.

locations.name: MBA Hall
locations.directions: From the Senate building, follow the road to the left for about 400m. MBA Hall is beside the Faculty of Social Sciences.

locations.name: Student Union Building (SUB)
locations.directions: From the main gate, walk 200m and turn left. The SUB is the busy building with the painted murals.

locations.name: University Health Centre
locations.directions: From the Senate building, take the road heading east for 300m. The Health Centre is on your right, opposite the car park.

locations.name: School of Communication
locations.directions: From the main gate, take the left road for 600m. The School of Communication is the building with the broadcast mast.

locations.name: Main Gate (Abebe Village Road)
locations.directions: The primary entrance on Abebe Village Road, Yaba.

locations.name: Faculty of Engineering
locations.directions: From the main gate, turn right at the first roundabout and walk 400m. Engineering is the cluster of buildings on the hill.

locations.name: Faculty of Law
locations.directions: From the main gate, go straight for 300m. Law Faculty is on your left, a red-brick building before the senate.

locations.name: Senate House
locations.directions: The tall landmark building at the centre of campus. Visible from most entry points.

locations.name: Jaja Hall (Hostel)
locations.directions: From the senate, follow the road behind it north for 500m. Jaja Hall is the first hostel block on your right.

locations.name: University Bookshop
locations.directions: From the senate, walk 100m west. The bookshop is in a single-storey building beside the car park.

locations.name: Sports Centre & Stadium
locations.directions: From the main gate, take the road to your left for 600m. The sports complex is by the lagoon side.

locations.name: Faculty of Business Administration
locations.directions: From Senate House, take the road south for 200m. Business Admin is the four-storey glass building.

locations.name: Main Gate
locations.directions: The iconic arched gate on the Ibadan-Ife expressway.

locations.name: Faculty of Technology
locations.directions: From the main gate, take the campus road for 1.2km and turn left at the water tower. Tech Faculty is 300m ahead.

locations.name: Great Hall (Oduduwa Hall)
locations.directions: From the roundabout at the centre of campus, follow signs for 200m. The Great Hall is the iconic amphitheatre-style building.

locations.name: Hezekiah Oluwasanmi Library
locations.directions: Behind the Great Hall, 150m north. The large multi-storey building with the famous clock tower.

locations.name: Faculty of Pharmacy
locations.directions: From the main gate, take the road to your right for 800m. Pharmacy is in the health science cluster.

locations.name: Student Union Building
locations.directions: From the roundabout, take the road south-west for 400m. The SUB is beside the cafeteria block.

locations.name: Main Gate (UI Road)
locations.directions: The primary entrance on UI Road, off Secretariat Road, Ibadan.

locations.name: Kenneth Dike Library
locations.directions: From the main gate, go straight for 600m. The Kenneth Dike Library is the large multi-storey building on the left.

locations.name: Faculty of Science
locations.directions: From Kenneth Dike Library, turn right and walk 300m. Science Faculty is on your left.

locations.name: Faculty of Arts
locations.directions: From the main gate, take the second left. Arts faculty is 200m ahead, a two-storey building.

locations.name: Trenchard Hall
locations.directions: At the centre of campus, follow signs from any main road. The iconic hall used for major events.

locations.name: International Students Hostel
locations.directions: From the main gate, follow the road for 1km past the sports centre. ISH is on the right near the guest house.

locations.name: Main Gate (Samaru)
locations.directions: Off the Zaria bypass road. The gate has the ABU crest.

locations.name: Senate Building
locations.directions: From main gate, go straight for 500m. The Senate is the tall administrative block at the centre.

locations.name: Faculty of Engineering
locations.directions: From Senate, go east for 600m. Engineering is the large complex with workshops.

locations.name: University Library
locations.directions: Adjacent to the Senate Building, on the north side.

locations.name: Main Gate
locations.directions: On KM 10 Idiroko Road, Ota. The gate with the Covenant University signage.

locations.name: Chapel of Light
locations.directions: The prominent chapel building at the heart of the campus, visible from the main gate.

locations.name: College of Science & Technology
locations.directions: From Chapel of Light, take the road east for 300m. CST is the modern glass building.

locations.name: Main Gate
locations.directions: Off the Enugu-Nsukka Road, Nsukka.

locations.name: University Library
locations.directions: From the main gate, go straight for 600m. The Library is the large building on the right.

locations.name: Faculty of Engineering
locations.directions: From the library, turn left and walk 400m.

locations.name: Main Gate
locations.directions: Off Akure-Owo Road, Akure.

locations.name: Senate Building
locations.directions: From the main gate, go straight for 400m. The Senate is the central building.

locations.name: Main Gate
locations.directions: On the Lagos-Ibadan Expressway, Ilishan-Remo, Ogun State.

locations.name: Main Gate
locations.directions: East-West Road, Choba, Port Harcourt.

locations.name: Faculty of Engineering
locations.directions: From the main gate, go straight for 700m, turn left at the second junction.
